subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require confirmation by default across Control UI, TUI, and Gateway/channel command surfaces, and should OpenClaw add any opt-out/config surface?
rationale: The behavior is source-reproducible, but changing documented slash-command semantics and adding config surface are product/API choices rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add one confirmation for `/new` and hard `/reset` across command surfaces, keep `/reset soft` immediate, and defer config until maintainers approve an opt-out.

options.title: Make confirmation configurable
options.body: Add confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting the schema, docs, and upgrade-policy burden.

options.title: Keep typed commands immediate
options.body: Preserve slash commands as intentional destructive actions and limit confirmation to visible UI affordances only.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add one confirmation for `/new` and hard `/reset` across command surfaces, keep `/reset soft` immediate, and defer config until maintainers approve an opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged confirmation PR and its explicit typed-command preservation are closest to the remaining product choice.
